description: An empty object attribute doesn't change another attribute's map type when objects unify
notes: The input needs a null map whose element type is the dynamic pseudo-type (md), which the spec has no value for: the dynamic pseudo-type is a placeholder for a type that isn't known yet, so no value should have it as a collection's element type. Apart from that, the spec gives the same result. hashicorp/hcl unifies objects with different attribute names to a map whose element type unifies all the attribute types (unifyObjectTypesToMap in cty/convert/unify.go). For a map of strings, a map of the dynamic pseudo-type and an empty object, unifyObjectsAsMaps fails because the empty object has no attribute types to unify, so unify ranks the three types (compareTypes in cty/convert/compare_types.go) and takes the map of strings, which the empty object converts to as an empty map. The spec gives an object type with all three attributes, where p keeps its type. Either way p is an unknown map of strings.
